description: Rules identifying garments, footwear, accessories, silhouettes, fabrics, colors, and styling characteristics that are generally incompatible with specific occasions.

override_principle.default: Occasion incompatibilities should strongly influence style-board ranking.
override_principle.override_condition: If the user explicitly requests an unconventional, rebellious, fashion-forward, or deliberately inappropriate interpretation, soft incompatibilities may be reduced.
override_principle.hard_override_note: AHVI should not claim something is conventionally appropriate merely because the user requests it.

important_context_rules.description: Do not assume every workplace has the same dress code.
important_context_rules.action: Use formal_business, business_casual, or creative_work according to the user's stated context.

important_context_rules.description: Do not assume every wedding, religious ceremony, or festive event has identical cultural expectations.
important_context_rules.action: Use the user's stated cultural, venue, and dress-code context when available.

important_context_rules.description: Occasion incompatibility should affect ranking rather than automatically deleting every look.
important_context_rules.action: Hard-exclude only when the garment is explicitly incompatible with the occasion or user-specified dress code.

important_context_rules.description: A user-requested aesthetic can intentionally challenge conventional occasion styling.
important_context_rules.action: Reduce soft penalties when the user explicitly requests unconventional styling.
